faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TMC PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) position at Tata Memorial Hospital is 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN)?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) post in the Tata Memorial Hospital recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a P.G Degree or Graduate Degree in Science/Commerce Field with a 6-month computer course or MS-CIT certificate, along with relevant years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 40,000.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening of applications, an MCQ test (if applicable), an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the TMC PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Tata Memorial Hospital (TMC).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the PROJECT ASSISTANT (ADMIN) post is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, which will be available on the TMC website.
